set.body:
Child slice of Interaction 08 (bd-01M1Z9B3FPJXKAYSYYF1DF7Q9M), split by agreement with codex-intaglio-help (msg-01M3ZPXZZ60HKCSCVZF6MVHQC6), who keeps Canvas/SvgWidget/WidgetOptions/build.sbt.
Scope: (a) docs/browser-capabilities.md: the ggiraph-derived baseline matrix from docs/design/interaction.md, one row per required behaviour in each of the eight areas (inspection, emphasis, actions, selection, plot parts, navigation, composition, embedding), with SVG and Canvas columns. Each cell is PASS with a named receipt (test/check name, exact SHA, report path), PENDING, or GAP with reason. No cell is promoted from a demo of another backend or from serialized SVG. (b) tools/check-browser-consumer.sh + tools/browser-consumer/: an external Scala.js consumer that resolves the exact tested artifact (publishLocal of a clean checkout at a named SHA, version recorded), compiles a two-widget app against the public API only, links it, and runs a Playwright smoke check; fails if it resolves sibling sources.
Acceptance: matrix covers every baseline row with honest status; consumer passes at an exact SHA; Canvas column filled from codex-intaglio-help's receipts when their 08 manifest is ready, independently re-verified (native pixels + normalized trace equality), else left PENDING.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 08b] Baseline certification matrix and external browser consumer
